homepage_section_flow.description: Sticky top bar with blurred cream background, Erica circular logo, navigation pills (Home, Vendors, Compare Prices, Calculators, Resources), and 'Join Circle' primary button.

Split layout. Left: Eyebrow tag 'BIOHACKING & PEPTIDE EDUCATION', massive serif headline ('Find what works. Get your joy back.'), introductory bio paragraph, primary CTA buttons ('Join Community', 'Explore Vendors'). Right: Portrait frame with Erica's picture, subtle rose-gold ambient ring, and before/after -90 lb transformation highlight pill.
3-column grid featuring high-impact metrics: '100,000+ Lives Impacted', 'Trusted by Thousands', 'Hundreds of Resources & Protocols'.
Mini video/audio welcome card featuring Erica's avatar, 'A 56-second intro', play button, and hover-to-preview audio label.
NEW required section! Auto-scrolling or swipeable testimonial cards with quotes, reviewer initial avatar circle, verified customer badge, and rating stars. Data fetched from `/api/reviews`.

High-conversion grid for top recommended peptide & wellness vendors. Each card includes vendor circular logo/avatar, name, 'Active' green badge, short review/desc, rose-pink promo percentage tag, copyable discount code chip with instant feedback, and 'Shop <Name>' primary button.
Rose-gold gradient featured banner card promoting the Peptide Price Comparison tool (/compare) with arrow icon and 'Find Your Best Fit' header.
1-on-1 Coaching invitation card with Calendly booking integration, 'Ready to get your energy back?', and booking count pill.
5 community pillar cards (Skool Community, YouTube Channel, Weekly Newsletter, Podcast, Inner Circle Text Club) with distinct icon badges, member counts, and actionable CTAs.
Grid of secondary lifestyle, skincare, and supplement favorites (e.g., Primally Pure, AirDoctor, OLIVEDA) with discount codes.
Side-by-side promo banners for Bloodwork with Rythm ($10 off) and Erica's Amazon Favorites Storefront.
Full-width warm champagne block with bullet list of weekly inside perks (protocol breakdowns, research updates, flash sales), email input, and 'Subscribe Free' CTA button.
Dark obsidian or deep rose background footer with disclaimer text ('Educational purposes only, not medical advice'), copyright, logo, and quick links.

enhancements: Adopt bhwithbails.com card aesthetic with rose-gold accents.
Include active status indicator, copyable code pill with toast notification.
Keep existing category tabs (Peptides, Skin Care, Supplements, Telehealth, Clothes).
Preserve Peptide Nickname Guide callout box and data-testid attributes.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out, hover:-translate-y-1 transform transition-all
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Card glow borders, button scale 1.02 on hover, smooth copy-code pulse

data_testid_preservation_rules: Retain all 'data-testid' attributes in existing codebase including nav, vendor cards, compare price inputs, calculator tabs, and admin controls.
Add new data-testids for the reviews section and newly introduced community cards.
instructions_to_main_agent: Update `/app/frontend/src/index.css` or CSS config to include font imports and color variables.
Implement the complete `/app/frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx` according to the section blueprint.
Ensure backend endpoint `/api/reviews` exists or mock appropriately so the review carousel renders seamlessly.
Style components with Tailwind using generous padding, serif headlines, rose-gold accents (#B87A6A), and clean rounded-2xl cards.
